newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's Feb oil output up 1.48 pct vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's Feb oil output up 1.48 pct vs yr ago.

text.p: Ecuador produced an average of 391,517 barrels per day (bpd) of crude oil in February, up 1.48 percent from the same month last year, an official from the National Petroleum Directorate said Wednesday.
In February 1996, Ecuador produced an average of 385,779 bpd.
The official, who asked not to be identified, said average output in the first two months was 363,140 bpd. A comparative figure was not available.
"The damage in the Transecuadorean Pipeline System affected the output levels," said the official.
Oil production in Ecuador was an average of 383,858 bpd last year.
Ecuador exported 7.36 million barrels of crude oil in February, up from the 6.7 million shipped during the same month last year, the state oil firm Petroecuador said.
